kubectl: kubectl logs -n shop-orders -l app=checkout --tail=500 --max-log-requests=20 | grep -E 'Caused by|Exception' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10
kubectl logs -n shop-orders -l app=checkout --tail=500 --max-log-requests=20 --prefix | grep 'Caused by: java.net.ConnectException' | cut -d/ -f2 | sort | uniq -c

kray-triage: for i in $(seq 0 19); do kray logs checkout-$i -n shop-orders --tail 500 | grep -q '^errors:' && echo "checkout-$i has errors"; done
